name: supersub
description: Five skills that take a Power Platform app from design to delivery: design-md writes a DESIGN.md design system, mock-ui builds a clickable HTML mockup, create-app converts mockups or screenshots into paste-ready Power Apps Canvas YAML (.pa.yaml), create-list designs SharePoint lists and builds their Excel or CSV import files, and create-flow plans Power Automate flows and builds legacy import packages. Every output is linted offline, and anything unverified is labelled.
